## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Mahāyāna *sūtra* on the proper attitudes of respect (恭敬 *gōngjìng*) toward the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Saṅgha, translated by **Jñānagupta** 闍那崛多 ([闍那崛多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E5%B4%9B%E5%A4%9A)) at the Suí court late 6th century. Companion text to [KR6k0118](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0118) (*Zhèng gōngjìng jīng*).

**Abstract**

The text expounds the **etiquette of the Three Jewels** (Buddha, Dharma, Saṅgha): how a practitioner should approach, address, and honour each of the Three Jewels. Such etiquette texts supply the practical-behavioural foundation for monastic and lay Buddhist conduct.
